10216|1147bc15.name: Gubber Blump
10216|1147bc15.text: ...pan fried, deep fried, and stir fried...

1646|1d2a2e75.name: Baros Alexston
1646|1d2a2e75.text: Greetings, I am Baros Alexston, City Architect of Stormwind.

1684|820221cb.name: Khara Deepwater
1684|820221cb.text: There's never an end to the chores around here.

234|eba492ed.name: Gryan Stoutmantle
234|eba492ed.text: A foul corruption has crept into Westfall.  While I was upholding my duty on the battlefields of Lordaeron these honest farms were overrun and made into hide-outs for thugs and murderers. The People's Militia needs your help.

235|f83ef93f.name: Salma Saldean
235|f83ef93f.text: Welcome to our humble abode!  It's always nice to see a friendly face.  And what strong arms you have.  My husband and I are always looking for help around the farm.  Now that most the good folk have left, it's hard to find an able body to help out.

237|7ae4f953.name: Farmer Furlbrow
237|7ae4f953.text: Nothing but trouble in these parts.  I tried to tell that fool Saldean to get out while he still could be he won't hear of it.  But I ain't no fool.  Verna and I are gonna mosey on out as soon as we get this wagon fixed.

238|a3fa5a16.name: Verna Furlbrow
238|a3fa5a16.text: Sometimes I think there's a big gray cloud in the sky, just raining down bad luck upon us.  First, we're driven off our land, and now we can't even get out of Westfall.  Everything's a mess.  Something needs to be done.

246349|da04ef25.name: Breton Samuels
246349|da04ef25.text:
If you've come seeking the fellowship of your fellow paladins, you've come to the right place. 

Welcome home.

246389|8e0ab317.name: Hilda the Breaker
246389|8e0ab317.text:
Why do they call me "The Breaker"?

Trust me, you don't want to know.

246389|b676ae27.name: Hilda the Breaker
246389|b676ae27.text:
A little bit of a lot of things. Mostly I take the soft and weak and reshape them into hardened fighters once again.

It's a tough world out there, and even our own people mistrust us. We need to be tough and self-reliant if we are to fit into this "horde" with the rest of our people.

246393|a5383807.name: Jorin Croge
246393|a5383807.text: There are many things lurking out there in the dark and the light is needed now more than ever. If only these poor souls could see that just because our world has changed, that doesn't mean we have to be the monsters that the living think we are.

246393|af07d724.name: Jorin Croge
246393|af07d724.text:
I make sure we are provisioned and that the scant resources we do are distributed properly. 

If this were a proper order, I'd be something of a quartermaster. Such as we are however, I just do my best to make sure we are at least somewhat equipped to deal with the dangers all around us.

246394|63539e70.name: Ander Solliden
246394|63539e70.text: In my previous life, I lived nearby here. I still wander the fields of my childhood farmstead occasionally. It fills me with sadness to see those I knew and loved, shambling around as mindless thralls. It pains me, but its that very pain that gives me strength and purpose.

246394|82d61c10.name: Ander Solliden
246394|82d61c10.text:
Mostly the usual. Murloc attacks, the occasional Scarlet Crusade skirmish. There are even some paladins that can't quite adjust to life as a Forsaken. Far too often we have to put those down that turn their blades upon their brothers. 

By far the worst is when some mindless thrall wanders too close. I can kill murlocs all day, but some of the scourge I've had to destroy were former friends of mine. Some were even family members.

I'd rather it be me who puts them down than some random adventurer, but it still stings.

257655|9f0fb116.name: Deathguard Billmuth
257655|9f0fb116.text: <Deathguard Billmuth absentmindedly fidgets as he looks around nervously. He is clearly very uncomfortable being here.>

267007|37e215b2.name: Stormwind Harbor Guard
267007|37e215b2.text: Which class trainer are you looking for?

267007|9e9bec9c.name: Stormwind Harbor Guard
267007|9e9bec9c.text: What do you need directions to?

267007|dabedb39.name: Stormwind Harbor Guard
267007|dabedb39.text: Warlocks, eh.  Well, you didn't hear it from me, but I've heard rumors that those types gather at a bar called the Slaughtered Lamb in the Mage Quarter.

267008|b4ea9d59.name: Leonid Barthalomew the Revered
267008|b4ea9d59.text: They named it Bandarion Keep. I wonder what Garek would make of that?

276067|2af62916.name: Angus Hammerhand
276067|2af62916.text:
It's my job to get the Paladins of Bandarion Keep set up with proper arms and armor. It's not much, but it's honest work.

I've got a thing or two for sale as well, should you need gear.

2913|5112b624.name: Archaeologist Hollee
2913|5112b624.text: Who would have guessed the excavation would have uncovered such findings!

2930|cd94cda6.name: Sentinel Glynda Nal'Shea
2930|cd94cda6.text: Corruption sneaks into nature's grove.  The forest must be protected at all costs.

3616|29aa26bd.name: Onu
3616|29aa26bd.text:
The wind whispers to those who listen...

Do you hear it?

3649|17d06d6c.name: Thundris Windweaver
3649|17d06d6c.text: Dark forces encroach upon our borders, ancient taints resurface, and new evils emerge to topple the delicate balance of the land. In times of such darkness, we all must be vigilant.

6300|0b719f6c.name: Elisa Steelhand
6300|0b719f6c.text: How can I help you, friend?

1001-progress.name: Buzzbox 411
1001-progress.text: The machine's hatch is open and it seems to wait expectantly for 3 Thresher Eyes to be placed inside.
1001-progress.title: Buzzbox 411

1002-progress.name: Buzzbox 323
1002-progress.text: Though you have yet to place the 6 Moonstalker Fangs inside, you believe you hear the sounds of static and incoherent $r ramblings coming from within. Could someone else have fixed the machine already?
1002-progress.title: Buzzbox 323

1003-progress.name: Buzzbox 525
1003-progress.text:
You hear singing coming from Buzzbox 525.

"Though crawler wine's shweet, and thresher ale fine, and moonstalker moonshine ish grand. There's nothing sho dear, as a thistle bear beer, and shoon I shall have shome on hand!"

The hatch is open and awaits the 4 grizzled scalps as you hear the song repeated over and over.
1003-progress.title: Buzzbox 525

102-progress.name: Captain Danuvin
102-progress.text: Have you collected 8 paws from those treacherous Gnolls yet?
102-progress.title: Patrolling Westfall

1138-progress.name: Gubber Blump
1138-progress.text:
...lemon crab, whipper root crab, and Ironforge surprise crab.  That's about it.

Oh, hello there $N.  Do you have them fine crab chunks I was telling you about?
1138-progress.title: Fruit of the Sea

1141-progress.name: Gubber Blump
1141-progress.text:
There's plenty of good dishes you use Darkshore groupers for.  They're good to eat, but I think it's more fun catching them.

You caught any Darkshore groupers yet?
1141-progress.title: The Family and the Fishing Pole

151-progress.name: Verna Furlbrow
151-progress.text: Old Blanchy is on her last leg.  Did you happen to find any oats for her?
151-progress.title: Poor Old Blanchy

153-progress.name: Scout Galiaan
153-progress.text: Bring me 15 red leather bandanas and I'll pay you well.
153-progress.title: Red Leather Bandanas

2178-progress.name: Alanndarian Nightsong
2178-progress.text: The pot is empty and I'm hungry! What's taking you so long?
2178-progress.title: Easy Strider Living

22-progress.name: Salma Saldean
22-progress.text: All I need for my famous meat pie are 8 Goretusk Livers!
22-progress.title: Goretusk Liver Pie

297-progress.name: Magmar Fellhew
297-progress.text: Do you have those Idols?  We must study them and report our findings to Ironforge!
297-progress.title: Gathering Idols

3524-progress.name: Gwennyth Bly'Leggonde
3524-progress.text: It is only recently that these creatures started landing on the coast of Darkshore in such alarming numbers.  I can't help but think that this is an ill omen of some sort.  Recovering a sample of that creature's bones to the south would help us in Darnassus assess this situation!
3524-progress.title: Washed Ashore

36-progress.name: Salma Saldean
36-progress.text: I'm going to miss that Verna Furlbrow so much.  I don't suppose you happened to see her on your way here?
36-progress.title: Westfall Stew

366-progress.name: Gunther Arcanus
366-progress.text: Your masters are fools to send you here, for I will never again be a Scourge slave!
366-progress.title: Return the Book

38-progress.name: Salma Saldean
38-progress.text:
Come back with the following ingredients: 
 
 3 Stringy Vulture Meat 
 3 Goretusk Snouts 
 3 Murloc Eyes 
 3 Okra
38-progress.title: Westfall Stew

405-progress.name: Bethor Iceshard
405-progress.text:
Greetings.  Either you do not know who I am, or your business with me is urgent.

Because if neither of these were true, then you would not be foolish enough to disturb me...
405-progress.title: The Prodigal Lich

410-progress.name: Lillith's Dinner Table
410-progress.text: This is an old, beaten, bloody table.
410-progress.title: The Dormant Shade

411-progress.name: Bethor Iceshard
411-progress.text: Have you returned Gunther's book?  Has he responded?
411-progress.title: The Prodigal Lich Returns

4681-progress.name: Gwennyth Bly'Leggonde
4681-progress.text: Once you have investigated the creature's remains in the water to the west of here, I should be able to file a proper report with the Temple of the Moon in Darnassus.  Perhaps then we will be closer to discovering the reason why these unfortunate creatures choose to end their lives beached on the coast of Darkshore.
4681-progress.title: Washed Ashore

4762-progress.name: Thundris Windweaver
4762-progress.text: The pollution of the Cliffspring River is but the start of an alarming trend here in Darkshore.  The sample you provide will help us formalize a plan... a plan of attack, I am starting to suspect.
4762-progress.title: The Cliffspring River

4763-progress.name: Thundris Windweaver
4763-progress.text: The Talisman of Corruption is a sinister device that only serves to pervert the balance of nature.  When you obtain this item from whatever satyr is tormenting the furbolgs and bring it to me for disposal, we will have won a great victory this day!
4763-progress.title: The Blackwood Corrupted

4812-progress.name: Mysterious Red Crystal
4812-progress.text: The crystal looks very alien against the wooded scenery of Darkshore.  You think you hear a very slight humming coming from deep within it.
4812-progress.title: As Water Cascades

64-progress.name: Farmer Furlbrow
64-progress.text: Don't suppose you were able to get my watch?
64-progress.title: The Forgotten Heirloom

79008-accept.name: Unknown
79008-accept.text:
<The faint radiance of the embers darkening, you stumble across the remnants of a recent fire.

Amidst the scattered provisions, you discover a blistered note.>

"Not all that burns is lost. Find the twin land, find the place."
79008-accept.title: ... and that note you found

86614-complete.name: Khara Deepwater
86614-complete.text:
My hair clip! I thought this was lost for good!

This'll shine right up with just a little work. Thank you for bringing it to me! I'll make it worth your while.
86614-complete.title: Silver of the Waves

86614-progress.name: Khara Deepwater
86614-progress.text: I have a lot of chores today, so can you keep it quick?
86614-progress.title: Silver of the Waves

91282-complete.name: Breton Samuels
91282-complete.text: Another fresh recruit? Welcome to Tyr's Watch, sister.
91282-complete.title: A Second Home

91285-accept.name: Breton Samuels
91285-accept.text:
Normally we'd show our newcomers a bit more hospitality, but we've got a bit of a murloc problem at the moment.

A tribe of murlocs used to use the keep as their spawning grounds. They've been a problem since we moved in and kicked them out, but now it's starting to get out of hand. You look like you've seen some action. Do you think you could help us drive back some of these pests? You'll find them lurking in the bluffs along the road to the east, and in the camps around the lake to the west.
91285-accept.title: Murlocs at the Gates

91285-complete.name: Breton Samuels
91285-complete.text: We appreciate the assistance. I'm sure this won't stop the attacks entirely, but it'll hopefully slow them down a bit. It's hard enough rebuilding this place without a murloc trying to stab you in the back with a spear.
91285-complete.title: Murlocs at the Gates

91294-accept.name: Breton Samuels
91294-accept.text:
Now that the immediate threat of the murloc attacks is under control, I'd encourage you to show yourself around our stronghold. It isn't much yet, but it's home.

When you are done exploring, seek out Danitha Morr, our leader. She can help you get settled in.

I'm very glad to have met you, $N. May the light be your guide.
91294-accept.title: Touring the Grounds

91294-complete.name: Danitha Morr
91294-complete.text:
Breton sent you up here, eh? Excellent.

My name is Danitha Morr, and I am the closest thing this keep has to a commander. If you come seeking fellowship amongst those that still remain loyal to the light, you've come to the right place.

There's a lot of work to do here before we can fully establish ourselves, and we'd be most appreciative if you would be willing to lend aid.
91294-complete.title: Touring the Grounds

91316-accept.name: Jorin Croge
91316-accept.text:
This far from the Undercity, logistics are challenging and we have a dire shortage of building materials needed to help restore this fortress. I'd like your help with that.

The ruined village of Shadowvale can be found in the Whispering Forest, just southwest of here. One of the buildings has an old root cellar used to store all sorts of things. There are likely to be usable materials down there. Scavenge what you can and return to us.
91316-accept.title: Making Repairs

91316-complete.name: Jorin Croge
91316-complete.text: I'm glad to see that your trip to Shadowvale bore fruit. I'll send Breton and a few of the other new recruits over later to clear the rest of the cellar out and retrieve anything left down in the dark.
91316-complete.title: Making Repairs

91316-progress.name: Jorin Croge
91316-progress.text: They say location is everything. While this fortress may look imposing perched upon these bluffs, its turning out to be quite the challenge to stay supplied this far from proper civilization. An unfortunate oversight on our part.
91316-progress.title: Making Repairs

91317-accept.name: Danitha Morr
91317-accept.text:
Not all risen paladins have acclimated well to our new existence, as you may have seen yourself already. Some have carried forward their prejudices from life, and continue to visit violence upon their fellow Forsaken.

As it stands we are mistrusted by our people who remember well the persecution inflicted by the living in the name of the light, and these attacks do not help. A number of these tarnished have taken up residence at Shadowvale to the southwest. End them and bring me their leader's head.
91317-accept.title: The Tarnished

91317-complete.name: Danitha Morr
91317-complete.text:
Excellent work, $N. Every time one of these Tarnished strike out and kill one of the Forsaken, it becomes that much easier for our detractors to stoke mistrust towards us paladins. Eliminating them will help further our cause and solidify our place here in Tirisfal.

I suspect it may take a long time for us to be fully embraced by the Forsaken and the horde. It could take years... or maybe even decades, but the best we can do is keep trying to prove ourselves.
91317-complete.title: The Tarnished

91317-progress.name: Danitha Morr
91317-progress.text: The Tarnished threaten what little goodwill we have with the other Forsaken. As much as it pains me to cross blades with our former brothers and sisters, they must be stopped if our fledgling order is to survive.
91317-progress.title: The Tarnished

944-progress.name: Scrying Bowl
944-progress.text:
The Master's Glaive, $N.

Go there, then speak with me again.
944-progress.title: The Master's Glaive

94427-accept.name: Danitha Morr
94427-accept.text:
A key tenant of being a $c is the pursuit of divinity. This is not the pursuit of godhood, but merely the pursuit of good itself, for good's sake. We've all arrived at this place due to tragedy of one form or another, and it would be easy to lose that grace that defined us as paladins in life.

Go to the Undercity and seek out Tanis Alderwood in the Trade Quarter. They are in need, and they could benefit greatly from some grace.
94427-accept.title: A Lesson in Divinity

947-progress.name: Barithras Moonshade
947-progress.text: Do you have my mushrooms, $N?  Have you been to the cave?
947-progress.title: Cave Mushrooms

95065-accept.name: Gilbert Gray
95065-accept.text:
What a view... Best an old man can ask for.

The fish sure are bitin' now, though I'm down to my last bait. I don't suppose you have any spare fishing supplies on you? Of course not, forgive me. I get so excited at the thought of casting another line it didn't dawn on me I may be one of the few carrying supplies everywhere I go.

Would you be able to help refresh my stock? Catherine Leland has an assortment of fishing goods just west of the Trade District along the canals. Tell her old Gray sent you.
95065-accept.title: Fishin' Time

955-progress.name: Asterion
955-progress.text: Once I have the earrings, I will cast the spell to search for the whereabouts of the seal that binds me. For centuries I have thought on the freedom destroying the seal would bring to me... Perhaps those centuries have taken a toll upon my mind that I might never recover...
955-progress.title: Bashal'Aran

956-progress.name: Asterion
956-progress.text:
The pillars of this shrine are as the bars of a prison to me, $N. No strength I still possess might break them, and no magic I wield might destroy them...

For a thousand years and more I have stared at them, wondering if at long last I outlived even the stone, would I be free? Or would it be invisible bars that held me then...
956-progress.title: Bashal'Aran

958-progress.name: Thundris Windweaver
958-progress.text: If only the tools of their undoing could have been destroyed in the cataclysm that destroyed our world... Nonetheless, we must do what we can to ensure that the horrors of our past are not repeated in the future.
958-progress.title: Tools of the Highborne

95803-accept.name: Danitha Morr
95803-accept.text:
Now that we've claimed the head of the tarnished commander, I need you to deliver it to the Undercity. Sylvanas Windrunner mistrusts us greatly, and all but openly disparages us.

Deliver Rudolph Gelhardt's head to the Dark Lady. Show her that we tend to our own house and are devoted to the prosperity of the forsaken.
95803-accept.title: A Token of Good Faith

963-progress.name: Cerellean Whiteclaw
963-progress.text: With a great sorrow in my heart, I followed the Shan'do Stormrage into hibernation, and took my sorrow to my dreams, sleeping for the passing of thousands of years.
963-progress.title: For Love Eternal

966-progress.name: Balthule Shadowstrike
966-progress.text: Have you found any more of their scrolls? I should be able to piece together a larger picture of the cult if you can find them.
966-progress.title: The Tower of Althalaxx

96896-accept.name: Leonid Barthalomew the Revered
96896-accept.text:
Danitha and I fought against the scourge in the defense of the Undercity when Naxxramas attacked. We lost many good friends that day, including the hero after which this keep was named--Garek Bandarion.

He might just have been the first Forsaken to rediscover how to wield the light as a $c. I am encouraged to see his legacy and potential live on here with Danitha and her cohort.

If only the rest of the forsaken felt the same way...
96896-accept.title: A Righteous Cause

96896-complete.name: Leonid Barthalomew the Revered
96896-complete.text: I plan to stay here for a time and speak with more of my friends, but I will return to Light's Hope Chapel in Eastern Plaguelands soon enough. Should you ever find yourself out that way, please do say hello. We could always use more help from able-bodied adventurers.
96896-complete.title: A Righteous Cause

96897-complete.name: Hadric Harlson
96897-complete.text: Thank you for your aid, $c. If we do not wish to see Lordaeron's history repeat itself, we've got to be vigilant when threats like this spring up.
96897-complete.title: The Cult of the Damned

96898-complete.name: Hadric Harlson
96898-complete.text: Thank you. This should slow the efforts of the scourge in this area. I suspect the denizens of Tirisfal will be pulling these crystals out of the ground for years, but removing the most conspicuous of them can only help.
96898-complete.title: Remnants of War

96898-progress.name: Hadric Harlson
96898-progress.text: I'd advise you not come into too much physical contact with those crystals. Even shattered and spent, the lingering magic in these necrotic crystals is highly dangerous.
96898-progress.title: Remnants of War

96899-accept.name: Hadric Harlson
96899-accept.text:
You've done a great thing for the cause of the Argent Dawn here today, and I thank you. I don't know how familiar you are with the fortress of Bandarion Keep, but my commander and I were headed that way to meet with the paladins that reside there. That was before we learned of the presence of the Cult of the Damned.

If you'd like to learn more about the Argent Dawn and our mission, seek out my commander at Bandarion Keep, to the northwest of here. I'll remain here to mop up the rest of this mess.
96899-accept.title: Bandarion Keep

96899-complete.name: Leonid Barthalomew the Revered
96899-complete.text:
This place is full of memories for me. This place was once held by the Argent Dawn. It was here from here that we prepared for many battles and skirmishes against the scourge during their most recent push into Tirisfal Glades.

When we withdrew to the Plaguelands I feared it would fall into disrepair. My fear was well-founded, but I am glad that Danitha and her paladins have taken over stewardship of it now.

She even named the keep after... a mutual friend.
96899-complete.title: Bandarion Keep

97914-complete.name: Baros Alexston
97914-complete.text: <Baros opens the letter and begins to read it, his smile fading.>
97914-complete.title: Expanding Horizons

97914-progress.name: Baros Alexston
97914-progress.text:
I can smell the sea on you, friend!

<Baros laughs.>

What brings you to Stormwind?
97914-progress.title: Expanding Horizons

97926-accept.name: Baros Alexston
97926-accept.text:
I wish it was that easy to help, $c. I really do.

Should you choose to spend more time in our lands, you will find that many are without. Stormwind's coffers are not what they once were, and what remains is spread thin.

Give this reply to the elder the next time you see him. It's not what he's hoping for, but it's all I have to offer right now.
97926-accept.title: Making Do

97926-complete.name: Thundris Windweaver
97926-complete.text:
Sad news indeed. Still, I thank you for making the journey.

With neither Stormwind nor Darnassus coming to aid us, it seems that Auberdine's fate is our own to decide.
97926-complete.title: Making Do

97926-progress.name: Thundris Windweaver
97926-progress.text: You have returned. What news comes from Stormwind?
97926-progress.title: Making Do

98025-complete.name: Sentinel Glynda Nal'Shea
98025-complete.text:
It is good to know that issue has been taken care of, but it saddens me that we could not find another way. Jai'vhanel had been somewhat of a guardian of this area for quite some time, and I am not sure what could have caused her decent into madness.

Regardless, thank you for your service today, $c. The roads to Auberdine are safe for travel once again.
98025-complete.title: WANTED: Jai'vhanel

98025-progress.name: Sentinel Glynda Nal'Shea
98025-progress.text: Greetings $c - what may the Sentinels assist you with today? Perhaps you are here to inquire about the bounty on Jai'vhanel?
98025-progress.title: WANTED: Jai'vhanel

98042-accept.name: Jec
98042-accept.text:
<As you tear away the single page from the Twilight Tome, a foreboding voice floods your mind, uninvited.>

They have failed.

You will be forgotten.

They will lose the eye they gained.
98042-accept.title: It's All Fun and Games Until...

982-progress.name: Gorbold Steelhand
982-progress.text: The captains of those ships were good night elves, and they deserve a better fate than they were given. Perhaps tending to their personal effects will be the best way to put their spirits to rest.
982-progress.title: Deep Ocean, Vast Sea

98247-accept.name: Unknown
98247-accept.text:
<A torn shipping label can be found on the side of the now fully stocked crate. Though the intended recipient is torn off, details of its origin still remain.

"Property of the Azeroth Commerce Authority. Please return empty crates or unfulfilled shipments to our local trade hub at the Three Corners crossroads in Redridge Mountains. Couriers will be compensated for their time and travel."

Beside the text is a crudely drawn map of the area near the aforementioned destination.>
98247-accept.title: Shipping Label

983-progress.name: Buzzbox 827
983-progress.text: Buzzbox 827 sits with an eerie silence. A single flashing light indicates that it needs 6 Crawler Legs to be placed in its holding box.
983-progress.title: Buzzbox 827

98461-accept.name: Archaeologist Hollee
98461-accept.text:
If you're heading out of Auberdine, I could use your help!

My dear friend Tarrel and I were classmates in school. Oh, he was such a quickfire on all things excavation! We got split up after graduation--him to Wetlands, and me to here in Darkshore.

<Hollee sighs, then her brow furrows slightly.>

Sorry, and his wife... Merrin.

It doesn't matter. If you go to the Wetlands, could you make sure he's alright? And maybe give him this? He's probably near Menethil Harbor. There's a boat straight there.
98461-accept.title: Unrequited Love

98545-accept.name: Leonid Barthalomew the Revered
98545-accept.text:
Since you are here, I'd like you to deliver this letter to an old friend of mine in the Undercity. I'd deliver myself but I have a somewhat colorful history with the Dark Lady, and it would be better if a neutral third party made the delivery.

You are looking for a goblin named Glix Xizzix in the Trade Quarter area of the Undercity. I'm sure he'd be happy to compensate you for your time.

<Leonid lets out a low chuckle as he hands you the letter.>
98545-accept.title: Leonid's Letter

99152-accept.name: Hilda the Breaker
99152-accept.text:
While the Tarnished in Shadowvale to the southwest are definitely a problem, we cannot allow the cellars below the town to fester into a full-blown Scourge uprising on Bandarion Keep.

I need to get these trainees up to snuff in case that happens. You, however, are going to receive what I like to call a crash course.

Travel beneath Shadowvale and retrieve some of their wretched bones so we can study them further. I need ones that still retain some of the initial reanimation magic--that's glowing ones.
99152-accept.title: As Above, So Below

99152-complete.name: Hilda the Breaker
99152-complete.text:
Well done, recruit. We might just make something out of you yet.

With these bones we may be able to better understand how such a threat was able to go unnoticed for so long.
99152-complete.title: As Above, So Below

99152-progress.name: Hilda the Breaker
99152-progress.text: You'd best not be returning empty-handed. I either need the bones I asked for, or your body on a stretcher to confirm you at least gave it your all trying to get them.
99152-progress.title: As Above, So Below

99153-accept.name: Ephram Barbaro
99153-accept.text:
Oi, you! Word travels quickly among our ranks. I heard about the work you did with the cultists around the remnants of the battle with Naxxramas.

Problem is, one of them cultists got away with a piece of the focusing crystal. Seems to still have some juice in it. Best guess we have is it's somewhere beneath Shadowvale. It's either raising 'em or making 'em stronger, and you don't want either one.

Find that crystal before this gets out of hand.
99153-accept.title: The One That Got Away

99153-complete.name: Ephram Barbaro
99153-complete.text: Well done--and quick, too! Now onto my favorite part...
99153-complete.title: The One That Got Away

99153-progress.name: Ephram Barbaro
99153-progress.text: Did you find the damned thing?
